method: Each command runs against an isolated copy of the current subject. Its listed testSetup applies equally to both arms. The positive arm runs current implementation; the second arm changes only the listed reversion. TypeScript changes are rebuilt before execution. Source bytes and build output are restored between controls. All probes use harness bounded serially. Exact-command positive reuse is explicit. A baseline-module arm returning zero is already-met evidence, not a new runtime fix.
